entities.description: Leonin planeswalker and healer.

entities.description: Warrior adept, sister of Kamahl.

entities.description: Pit fighter and druid, Jeska's brother.

entities.description: An event after which poisoned land blossomed anew.

events.summary: Freyalise sets a bomb to make Yawgmoth pay for his treachery.
events.quote: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

events.summary: Renegades attack Tezzeret's Planar Bridge with an aether disruptor.
events.quote: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

events.summary: Chandra is driven by anger at the man who took her father.
events.quote: Chandra was driven by her anger, directed particularly at the man who had taken her father from her.

events.summary: After the Helvault opens, a mage's powers return twice as strong.
events.quote: Hours after the Helvault opened, his powers returned twice as strong as before.

events.summary: Avacyn cleanses the world with the Cursemute.
events.quote: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

events.summary: Gideon and Nissa lead the Zendikari through the Eldrazi swarm.
events.quote: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

events.summary: Sea Gate is retaken.
events.quote: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

events.summary: A peace summit shows Urza and Mishra's grudge can end only in blood.
events.quote: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

events.summary: The Phyrexian contagion corrodes Karn's body while the praetors try to corrupt his mind.
events.quote: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

events.summary: Belzenlok turns Yar-Kul into a maggot; the frog that ate it becomes Yargle.
events.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

events.summary: While Jhoira restores the Weatherlight, Slimefoot becomes her first crew member.
events.quote: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

events.summary: A crystal holds the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark, given by Jhoira.
events.quote: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

events.summary: Ugin slept for centuries in a cocoon Sarkhan made from a Zendikari hedron shard.
events.quote: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron.

events.summary: Korvold is transformed at his own wedding and devours everything.
events.quote: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

events.summary: Djeru renounces the God-Pharaoh, admitting Samut was right.
events.quote: I was promised an afterlife, not this. Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.

events.summary: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead ravage Naktamun.
events.quote: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis, his spark lost, plots revenge on Zendikar.
events.quote: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

events.summary: Barrin destroys Tolaria as a funeral pyre for his family.
events.quote: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

events.summary: The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria begins.
events.quote: The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria had finally begun.

events.summary: Elspeth's light pierces Elesh Norn.
events.quote: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her.

events.summary: Wrenn, burning, bends Realmbreaker to her will.
events.quote: Even as she burned, Wrenn bent Realmbreaker to her will.

events.summary: Chandra incinerates the bound Eldrazi titans while Gideon holds off the brood lineages.
events.quote: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

events.summary: The Planeswalker strike team is scattered on arrival at New Phyrexia.
events.quote: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scattered the Planeswalker strike team on arrival.

events.summary: Elspeth sacrifices herself, consigning a world-destroying blast to the void.
events.quote: Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.

events.summary: Nine planeswalkers seek to annihilate Phyrexia to save Dominaria.
events.quote: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers sought the annihilation of Phyrexia itself.

events.summary: Lord Xander is found dead.
events.quote: Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!

events.summary: Urza senses that his brother Mishra is dead.
events.quote: It was then he knew his brother was no more.

events.summary: Odric succumbs to the vampire's curse.
events.quote: But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

events.summary: Liliana betrays Bolas, and the cost falls on someone else.
events.quote: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet dies, leaving behind the components for his rebirth.
events.quote: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

events.summary: Angrath is trapped on Ixalan.
events.quote: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas.
